name: miwale Game Style Library
description: Complete, playable art styles for games, documented so AIs can copy and adapt them.
license: Free to copy and adapt for your own games. Credit appreciated: miwale.com/styles
howToUse: Pick a style whose mood and genre fit your game.
Give your AI the STYLE.md of that style (or the "Copy prompt" text from the page) together with your game idea.
Let it start from starter.js, which already contains the palette and the core drawing techniques.

styles.name: Harvest 16-Bit
styles.summary: Cozy SNES-era autumn farmland: warm hue-shifted pixel sprites, leaf-litter carpets, furrowed fields and wooden HUD panels.

styles.name: Pumpkin Boy
styles.summary: A pumpkin-tinted handheld LCD: exactly four shades, Bayer dithering, crisp outlined mini sprites at 2 world units per pixel.
bestFor: farming or harvest games with a spooky twist
game jams with a strict palette

styles.name: Gothic Night
styles.summary: Moonlit cursed churchyard in detailed pixel art: a banded light map darkens a cold world; only faces, lanterns and candles glow warm.

styles.name: Dusk Grove
styles.summary: Modern HD-2D pixel art: an enchanted forest clearing at golden-to-violet dusk, rim-lit sprites, banded glows, bloom and long shadows.
bestFor: farming/forest games with a night cycle

styles.name: Brotato Cartoon
styles.summary: Candy-bright HD vector cartoon: thick deep-plum outlines, one cel-shade crescent, one white gloss and bouncy squash & stretch.

styles.name: Paper World
styles.summary: A handmade craft-table diorama: cut construction-paper puppets with white sticker rims and brass split pins on layered kraft, felt and newsprint.

styles.name: Watercolor Storybook
styles.summary: Transparent watercolour washes and loose, broken ink lines on warm cold-pressed paper: a living illustrated fairy-tale book.
bestFor: top-down survivor / action games with a fairy-tale theme

styles.name: Neon Midnight
styles.summary: Glowing neon tube line-art with baked halos on a near-black holographic floor of circuit, hex and halftone regions.

styles.name: Low-Poly Diorama
styles.summary: A toy-like autumn miniature world of flat-shaded triangle facets in soft afternoon light, with tilt-shift blur at the screen edges.

styles.name: Linocut
styles.summary: A moving linocut print: cream paper, carbon-black key plate, one misregistered pumpkin-orange spot plate and a sparing teal.

styles.name: 8-Bit Arcade
styles.summary: A lost NES cartridge: strict 2C02 palette, black-outlined 3-colour sprites, tile-language meadows and checker-flicker ghosts.

styles.name: Cathedral Glass
styles.summary: A living cathedral window: jewel-tone glass pieces in dark lead came, lit from behind by warm light and coloured rays.

styles.name: Clay World
styles.summary: Stop-motion plasticine miniature set: soft gradient-built clay figures with fingerprints, warm studio light and 12 fps boil.

styles.name: Chalkboard
styles.summary: Drawn live with pastel chalk on a slate-green school board: broken grainy strokes, loose hatching, eraser smears and doodles.

styles.name: Trick or Treat
styles.summary: A glossy Halloween candy world: hard-candy shine, gummy jelly, matte marshmallow and chocolate on a melting chocolate floor.

styles.name: Cross-Stitch Sampler
styles.summary: The whole game is a living cross-stitch sampler on Aida cloth: every cell is a real thread X, contours are backstitched.
bestFor: puzzle and board-like games on a grid

styles.name: Pop-Art Comic
styles.summary: A printed 1960s comic book come alive: brush-ink outlines, flat process colours, Ben-Day dots and slipped colour plates.

styles.name: Starry Night
styles.summary: A living Van Gogh night painting: every surface is thick, swirling impasto brush strokes in ultramarine, viridian and cadmium yellow.

styles.name: Shadow Theatre
styles.summary: Backlit paper shadow-puppet theatre: indigo-black cut-paper silhouettes over glowing teal, violet, crimson and amber light fields.
bestFor: survivor-likes and hordes with many enemies
rhythm games with a stage theme

styles.name: Voxel Cube World
styles.summary: A bright MagicaVoxel-style miniature world: every actor is a real 3D cube grid, baked to sprites under one warm afternoon sun.
